tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: the journal page. Every stop sits on paper; the Night stop flips it to the 2am ground.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised paper: photo borders, the experiment index card, the voice-note capsule, the ignition key.

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: Scanned objects only (certificates, emails, screenshots). Slightly greyer than paper so a scan reads as a copy, not the page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Enfield black. Primary text and the heaviest marks, on paper, card and scan (15.9:1 / 17.3:1 / 14.9:1 day; 13.8:1+ night). The 3D bike is graded to this black, never #000.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Graphite. Secondary text, kickers, captions, meta, on paper, card and scan (6.0:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Ruled lines and hairlines: road edges, card dividers, scan borders. Decorative only, never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: wave-rest
tokens.usage: Unplayed waveform bars and the parked-bike road dashes; 3.3:1+ on paper, card and scan in both themes.

tokens.name: red-pen
tokens.usage: THE accent. A teacher's red pen: corrections, strike-throughs, 'I kill it if', and the live-mic dot. As text on paper, card and scan (5.0:1+ day, 6.2:1+ night). Never a fill larger than a dot or a pen stroke.

tokens.name: on-red-pen
tokens.usage: Text or icon on a red-pen fill (the listening mic disc).

tokens.name: haldi
tokens.usage: Turmeric from the kitchen, and the yellow cap of an Indian national-highway milestone. Only on milestone caps (past years) and, via highlight, a marker swipe. Fill only; text on it is on-haldi.

tokens.name: on-haldi
tokens.usage: Text on a haldi fill (milestone cap labels): 8.0:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Haldi highlighter swipe behind one phrase per stop. Text over it stays ink.

tokens.name: signboard
tokens.usage: Indian highway direction-sign green. Only for what is ahead: the next-year milestone cap, the Wispr Flow sign, the mountain-cafe sign at the road's end.

tokens.name: on-signboard
tokens.usage: Text, arrows and the inset border on a signboard fill (7.3:1 day, 5.5:1 night).

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Masking tape holding photos and scans to the page. Translucent so the photo shows through.

tokens.name: headlamp
tokens.usage: The bike's headlamp. Used only for the headlamp glow in the hero (engine on) and on the Night stop, where it is the only light.

styles.name: stop-title
styles.usage: One per stop, the claim. Mobile: 36px. Max ~9 words.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Week one at Wispr Flow India
styles.usage: Sub-heads inside a stop, experiment titles, the garage headline. Mobile: 26px.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I got 80. He bought it anyway. Best deal I ever lost.
styles.usage: The witty second line under a stop title. Italic is the aside voice. Mobile: 20px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I spoke to around 200 users before I paused it.
styles.usage: Story copy. Max 34rem measure, 3 short paragraphs per stop. Mobile: 17px.

styles.name: night-line
styles.sample: June 2025 was the lowest point of my life.
styles.usage: The single straight line of the Night stop. Light weight, no italic, no wit. Mobile: 25px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers only. Tabular figures. Mobile: 80px.

styles.name: milestone
styles.usage: The year on a milestone stone. Small lane stones: 22px.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase. Stop kickers, card ids, sign sub-lines, stat labels' units. Colour pencil.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Voice-note durations, timestamps, counters. Tabular figures.

styles.name: pen
styles.usage: Red-pen replacements in a correction. Colour red-pen. ~1.3× the text it corrects.

styles.name: scribble
styles.sample: only boy in the kitchen. won anyway.
styles.usage: Photo captions and margin notes, colour ink or pencil. Lowercase, no full stop needed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge, waveform bar gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: kicker to title, meta rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside controls: voice-note gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter. Card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between paragraphs and their object.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a stop header and its first object.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between objects inside a stop (photo to stat).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter at 1280+; top padding of a stop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Silence: above and below the Night line, before the garage.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Road between stops on desktop: scroll distance the bike rides with nothing else on screen.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Paper is cut square: photos, scans, cards, the night page.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Tape ends, small tags, the scan sheet's corners.

tokens.name: radius-soft
tokens.usage: Signboards (real ones are slightly rounded), the transcript drawer.

tokens.name: radius-stone
tokens.usage: Top corners of a milestone stone only (the dome). Lane-size stones: 22px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Voice things only: the ignition key, the voice-note capsule, the play button.

shadow.note: Paper on paper. Objects cast a contact shadow, nothing floats. No glows except the headlamp.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for text, cards drawn on the page, signboards.

tokens.name: shadow-contact
tokens.usage: Taped photos, scans, the index card: a sheet lying on the page.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The one object being handled: hover/press on a photo or scan, the ignition key while listening.

tokens.name: shadow-ground
tokens.usage: Contact shadow under the bike and milestone stones in the lane.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a paper gap then a solid 2px ink ring (15.9:1 day, 13.8:1 night).

layout.note: Plain CSS values for page structure.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of story copy.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a stop's content column pair.

tokens.name: lane-h
tokens.usage: Bike lane height on desktop and tablet (600+): just the bike and its thin road. The lane is see-through.

tokens.name: lane-h-mobile
tokens.usage: Bike lane height on phones, plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

tokens.name: stop-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of one stop: one stop per screen.

timing.note: Durations and easings. Motion rules live in the Motion section.

tokens.name: dur-tap
tokens.usage: Button press, tab, toggle.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: Photo or scan settling onto the page; transcript drawer.

tokens.name: dur-ink
tokens.usage: Ink/smoke spread between stops.

tokens.name: dur-ride
tokens.usage: Bike riding one stop to the next when scroll-snapped.

tokens.name: ease-throttle
tokens.usage: Pull away and ride: slow clutch, smooth cruise, gentle brake.

tokens.name: ease-brake
tokens.usage: Arrivals: things that stop (bike at milestone, photo landing).

tokens.name: ease-ink
tokens.usage: Ink bloom: hesitates, floods, slows as it soaks.
